title: Klippo Subcategory Prompt Variation Library
source: Additive structured library derived from prompts/prompt_component_tables.json subcategories; existing master prompts remain unchanged.
selection_policy: Select one variation for the exact selected subcategory; avoid the last three choices for that subcategory. Use category-safe actions and only reference-visible details.
global_rules: Preserve the exact visible product identity, shape, colour, pattern, labels, proportions and supplied parts.
Do not invent functions, materials, ingredients, accessories, claims, prices, discounts or results.
Keep actions physically plausible; simplify to a camera-only detail reveal if the reference does not support the action.
Do not force a human, child or animal model; follow the user's explicit model selection and model-safety rules.
No on-screen text, captions, extra logos or watermark unless the user explicitly selected text.

variations.name: Window-Light Outfit Reveal
variations.hook: Open with the full women's outfit in a softly lit room, clearly showing the actual neckline, sleeve shape, length and overall silhouette. Preserve the reference colour, print and styling exactly; no text, captions or added logos.
variations.action: The wearer steps once into the brighter part of the room and settles naturally, allowing the garment to fall into its existing shape without tugging or restyling it.
variations.detail: Show only visible design details such as the neckline, sleeve edge, waist seam or hem where present. Do not invent lining, pockets, fastenings or fabric properties.
variations.camera: Start in a medium-full frame and glide backward to a full-outfit view, keeping the same wearer and garment proportions throughout.
variations.lighting: Use broad window light with gentle fill and consistent exposure; retain natural skin tones and the garment's true colour.
variations.closing: Hold a still full-length front view with the outfit unobstructed for the final beat.
variations.audio: Use gentle modern instrumental music at low volume; no spoken claims or exaggerated transition sounds.

variations.name: Pleat and Hem Movement
variations.hook: Begin with the real hemline and any visible pleats or folds in focus, then reveal enough of the outfit to establish its full shape. Keep all visible edges and print placement faithful to the reference.
variations.action: The model takes one small sideways step and stops, letting the hem move briefly before settling; do not spin or lift the garment.
variations.detail: Highlight only the actual hem finish, pleats or folds visible in the reference. Do not add lace, trim, slits or extra layers.
variations.camera: Tilt smoothly from the lower garment to a balanced full-length frame, with no whip-pan and no cropping of the hem.
variations.lighting: Use soft diffused light with a natural floor shadow, preserving detail in both light and dark fabric.
variations.closing: End on a full-length still frame once the hem has settled.
variations.audio: A faint fabric rustle is appropriate only if the movement supports it; keep music restrained.

variations.name: Neckline and Shoulder Study
variations.hook: Open on the real neckline and shoulder line, then widen to show how those details connect to the complete outfit. Preserve the exact collar shape, sleeve attachment and any visible fastening.
variations.action: The wearer gently turns their upper body a few degrees and returns to front, keeping hands away from the neckline.
variations.detail: Show only visible neckline edges, seams or fastenings that exist; do not add jewellery, buttons or decorative stitching.
variations.camera: Use a stable close-to-medium composition followed by a slow pullback to a medium-full frame; avoid lens distortion.
variations.lighting: Soft off-axis light defines the shoulder and neckline without shifting colour or creating artificial shine.
variations.closing: Finish with the neckline and most of the outfit visible in a steady front-facing pose.
variations.audio: Use clean low-volume instrumental music; no handling sounds because the wearer does not touch the garment.

variations.name: Pattern Placement Walk-By
variations.hook: Show the outfit front-on first so its actual print, motifs or colour blocking can be read. Do not create extra symbols, text or branding, and keep the pattern's scale consistent.
variations.action: The model walks two calm steps across the frame and stops in a slight three-quarter pose; movement remains gentle enough to preserve pattern continuity.
variations.detail: Focus on the genuine placement of the print across visible panels. Do not mirror motifs, change their spacing or claim anything about fabric quality.
variations.camera: Track laterally at a steady distance with the full outfit in frame; avoid a fast orbit or sudden zoom.
variations.lighting: Use even daylight with stable white balance so the print does not change colour between frames.
variations.closing: Hold the three-quarter pose, then settle into a clean view with the key print area unobstructed.
variations.audio: Choose a light rhythmic instrumental bed; footsteps only if they match the visible surface.

variations.name: Flat-Lay to Worn Cut
variations.hook: If the supplied reference includes a flat-lay or hanging view, begin with that exact garment and transition by a clean cut to the same item worn; otherwise keep the original setup and do a camera-only reveal. No added props or text.
variations.action: Use one simple cut between compatible views; do not morph the garment or invent a dressing action.
variations.detail: Maintain the same colour, pattern, visible seams, sleeve shape and hem in both views. Do not add accessories or hidden construction.
variations.camera: Use two similarly composed shots with a clean cut and stable scale; no shape-distorting transition.
variations.lighting: Match the light direction and colour balance across both shots to keep the product identity consistent.
variations.closing: Hold the complete worn outfit or original presentation in a clear final frame, depending on the reference.
variations.audio: A soft music beat may mark the cut; no magical transformation sound or spoken claims.

variations.name: Natural Drape in a Still Pose
variations.hook: Present the complete outfit against a plain, quiet background before movement starts, allowing its true cut and drape to register. Keep the reference styling unchanged.
variations.action: The wearer shifts weight once and relaxes their shoulders; no wind, dramatic swaying or deliberate reshaping of the garment.
variations.detail: Show the actual folds and silhouette only. Do not assert softness, breathability, stretch, wrinkle resistance or any unverified fabric feature.
variations.camera: Keep the camera almost locked, with a very slow straight push-in that retains the garment's defining outline.
variations.lighting: Use broad diffused light and subtle shadow gradients so folds remain visible without altering colour.
variations.closing: Stop the camera and hold the outfit still in a full or medium-full view.
variations.audio: Use a quiet instrumental bed; avoid artificial wind or fabric effects.

variations.name: Sleeve Detail to Full Look
variations.hook: Begin close on a real sleeve cuff, sleeve edge or visible sleeve pattern, then reveal the complete outfit. Keep the sleeve length, shape and pattern unchanged.
variations.action: The model lowers one arm naturally from a relaxed bent position to their side, then becomes still.
variations.detail: Feature only the visible cuff, seam and sleeve drape; do not invent buttons, thumb loops, embroidery or special fabric performance.
variations.camera: Start with a steady close detail and pull back continuously to a medium-full composition, keeping the garment centred.
variations.lighting: Use soft side light to define the sleeve edge while retaining natural skin tone and true garment colour.
variations.closing: End with the sleeve unobstructed and enough of the outfit visible to identify the full design.
variations.audio: Keep music soft; a small fabric rustle is optional only if the arm movement plausibly produces it.

variations.name: Front-to-Profile Fit Check
variations.hook: Open with the complete outfit facing forward so its real fit and proportions are clear. Maintain the same wearer, hairstyle, accessories already present and garment details throughout.
variations.action: The model turns slowly to a three-quarter angle, pauses, and returns to front without spinning or changing pose dramatically.
variations.detail: Use the angle change to show only the visible side silhouette and seams; do not reveal imagined back details or reshape the waist or hem.
variations.camera: Use a level full-length shot and a very small camera arc that complements the turn without passing behind the model.
variations.lighting: Keep broad soft lighting consistent across both angles so colour and shadows remain believable.
variations.closing: Return to the opening front view and hold it still with the whole outfit visible.
variations.audio: Use understated fashion music with no runway crowd, applause or unsupported sound effects.

variations.name: Seated Detail, Standing Silhouette
variations.hook: If the reference outfit can naturally be shown seated, open with the wearer seated upright and the garment clearly visible; otherwise begin in a relaxed standing pose. Do not force a pose that hides or distorts the product.
variations.action: When seated, the model rises slowly in one continuous movement and stands still; when standing is the only suitable setup, they simply shift weight once.
variations.detail: Show how the existing garment settles after the movement without implying a guaranteed fit, comfort or suitability for other body types.
variations.camera: Use a fixed medium-wide frame with enough space for the full movement; avoid cuts during the rise and keep the hem inside frame.
variations.lighting: Maintain even soft light throughout the action to prevent changes in fabric shade or exposure.
variations.closing: Hold a relaxed full-outfit front view once the model is still.
variations.audio: Use gentle instrumental music and subtle room tone; no dramatic rise sound or spoken product claims.

variations.name: Editorial Full-Length Finish
variations.hook: Start with the entire outfit in a clean, uncluttered setting; use negative space from the background rather than adding props or graphics. Keep the product's actual cut, colour and print unchanged.
variations.action: The wearer takes one measured step toward a natural final mark and settles into a relaxed pose with hands clear of key details.
variations.detail: Allow the real silhouette, visible seams and hem to carry the shot. Do not imply occasion suitability or unverified material and quality claims.
variations.camera: Begin slightly wider to establish the setting, then make one slow straight push-in that ends with the complete outfit still inside frame.
variations.lighting: Use soft neutral light with gentle contrast; no artificial glow, dramatic colour grade or shifting highlights.
variations.closing: Finish on a steady, full-length hero frame with the wearer centred and the garment unobstructed.
variations.audio: Use polished but unobtrusive instrumental music beneath any selected narration; do not add unrequested spoken words or exaggerated effects.

variations.name: Silhouette Through a Doorway
variations.hook: Open with the actual outfit partly framed by a plain doorway, keeping its colour, print and proportions faithful to the reference. No text, graphics or added accessories.
variations.action: The wearer takes one calm step from behind the doorway into the open space, then pauses naturally without adjusting the garment.
variations.detail: Reveal the real overall silhouette and any visible seam or hem only; do not imply hidden construction or unverified fabric qualities.
variations.camera: Begin with a static vertical composition through the doorway, then make a slow lateral slide into an unobstructed full-length view.
variations.lighting: Use soft daylight from the open side of the room; maintain consistent exposure and the garment's true colour.
variations.closing: Finish with the complete outfit centred in the open space, held still for a clear final view.
variations.audio: Restrained instrumental music; no whoosh effect unless a visible transition genuinely supports it.

variations.name: Hemline Parallax Reveal
variations.hook: Start low on the real hem and lower edge of the outfit, with enough context to identify the garment. Preserve the exact hem shape and pattern placement.
variations.action: Move the camera gently sideways while the wearer remains still, creating natural background parallax without making the garment sway unnaturally.
variations.detail: Show only the visible hem finish, folds and adjacent print; do not add slits, lace, lining or trim.
variations.camera: Use a low, controlled slider move, then tilt up slightly to include the outfit's lower half; avoid a dramatic orbit.
variations.lighting: Use broad, even fill so dark and light areas retain detail without artificial shine.
variations.closing: Hold a clean lower-half composition with the hem fully visible and undistorted.
variations.audio: Soft tonal music only; no footsteps or fabric rustle when no movement produces them.

variations.name: Seam-Line Guided Pan
variations.hook: Open on a visible seam or panel boundary on the supplied garment; if no seam is clearly visible, begin on a real edge or print boundary instead.
variations.action: The camera follows the visible line slowly across the garment, ending at a wider view that explains where the detail sits on the outfit.
variations.detail: Do not invent stitching, pockets, buttons or construction; feature only details that can actually be seen in the reference.
variations.camera: Use a precise, steady macro-to-medium pan with a gentle rack focus; keep the garment surface undistorted.
variations.lighting: Use soft directional light grazing the surface just enough to reveal visible texture, without claiming a particular material.
variations.closing: End on a medium view that connects the close detail to the whole garment.
variations.audio: Minimal instrumental bed; no artificial clicking or sewing sounds.

variations.name: Mirror Angle Without Reflection Tricks
variations.hook: Present the outfit in a simple room with a plain mirror only if the reference setup supports one; otherwise use a clean front-facing composition without adding a mirror.
variations.action: The wearer makes a small natural quarter-turn and returns to the starting pose; keep the same outfit and visible styling throughout.
variations.detail: Use the angle to show only the visible side profile. Do not create a contradictory reflection, reveal imagined back details or alter the fit.
variations.camera: Keep the camera locked at chest height while the wearer turns; if a mirror is present, avoid reflection mismatches.
variations.lighting: Use balanced soft lighting from the front and side, preserving realistic skin tone and garment colour.
variations.closing: Return to a straightforward front view with the outfit fully readable.
variations.audio: Light contemporary instrumental music; no echo or mirror-themed sound effect.

variations.name: Fold-to-Form Match Cut
variations.hook: If a supplied product reference includes a folded or laid-out view, begin there and cut to the same garment presented in its existing full shape; otherwise use two compatible views of the same visible outfit.
variations.action: Make one clean match cut between similarly framed views; do not animate fabric into existence or simulate dressing.
variations.detail: Keep colour, print scale, visible seams and garment proportions consistent across the cut. Add no props or accessories.
variations.camera: Use a locked camera and match the garment's position across the cut; avoid morphing or liquid transitions.
variations.lighting: Match white balance and light direction between views so the product does not appear to change shade.
variations.closing: Hold the final complete view for a beat after the cut.
variations.audio: A gentle musical accent may mark the cut; avoid magical transformation sounds.

variations.name: Sleeve Shadow Study
variations.hook: Begin with a close view of the real sleeve shape and its shadow against the garment, then reveal the shoulder and upper-body outline.
variations.action: The wearer slowly raises and lowers one arm only if this can happen naturally without stretching or distorting the sleeve; otherwise keep the pose still and move the camera.
variations.detail: Show the visible sleeve opening, edge or seam only; do not add cuffs, buttons or decorative features.
variations.camera: Use a short diagonal camera move from sleeve detail to a medium frame, keeping the sleeve edge in focus.
variations.lighting: Use a soft side light to create a readable but gentle sleeve shadow; preserve the actual garment colour.
variations.closing: Finish with the sleeve unobstructed in a medium shot.
variations.audio: Low-volume instrumental music; a faint fabric sound only if movement plausibly creates it.

variations.name: Negative-Space Outfit Frame
variations.hook: Show the complete outfit against a plain background with generous empty space on one side; do not place text, logos or graphics in that space.
variations.action: The wearer shifts one step toward the open side of the frame and settles, allowing the full silhouette to remain visible.
variations.detail: Keep the outfit's original shape and styling. Empty space is compositional only and must not contain added objects or claims.
variations.camera: Use a wide, stable composition and a slow reframing move that balances the garment against the empty background.
variations.lighting: Use soft, even studio-style light with a natural floor shadow and no colour cast.
variations.closing: End with a balanced full-length composition and no cropping of the outfit.
variations.audio: Use a sparse, calm music bed; follow the selected voice setting exactly, with no added sound effects unless selected.

variations.name: Detail Focus Handoff
variations.hook: Open with the full outfit softly visible, then bring one genuine detail—such as a visible neckline, print motif, button or hem—into focus, choosing only what the reference actually contains.
variations.action: The wearer stays still while focus shifts from the overall outfit to the selected detail, then returns to the full view.
variations.detail: Never substitute a made-up detail. If no distinct feature is visible, focus on the actual outline or colour-block boundary instead.
variations.camera: Use a controlled rack focus on a tripod, with no camera shake and no extreme close-up that loses product identity.
variations.lighting: Use broad diffused light so the focus change reveals detail without altering texture or colour.
variations.closing: Return focus to the full outfit and hold the final composition.
variations.audio: Soft ambient instrumental sound; no click sound unless an actual visible action causes it.

variations.name: Slow Turn, Fixed Horizon
variations.hook: Begin with a complete front view and a level horizon so the garment's natural proportions are easy to judge.
variations.action: The wearer rotates slowly to a three-quarter angle, pauses briefly, then returns to front without spinning or dramatic posing.
variations.detail: Only show angles the movement genuinely reveals; do not invent rear design elements or claim fit suitability.
variations.camera: Keep the camera fixed and level; let the wearer provide the movement rather than orbiting the camera.
variations.lighting: Use consistent diffused lighting from start to finish, with stable white balance across the turn.
variations.closing: Finish on the same front-facing full view as the opening, held motionless.
variations.audio: Understated fashion instrumental; no runway crowd, applause or exaggerated whoosh.

variations.name: Quiet Fabric Settling
variations.hook: Open on the garment immediately after the wearer has come to rest, showing its existing folds and silhouette without a forced pose.
variations.action: The wearer relaxes their hands at their sides and remains still while any naturally moving folds settle; do not add wind or shake the fabric.
variations.detail: Describe visually only the real folds, edges and visible drape. Do not claim softness, stretch, breathability or wrinkle resistance.
variations.camera: Use a nearly locked medium-full shot with a very slow push-in, preserving the entire defining outline.
variations.lighting: Use gentle top-front fill and subtle side shadow to retain fold detail without creating glossy highlights.
variations.closing: End with a still, unobstructed outfit view and no sudden cut.
variations.audio: Quiet instrumental music; omit fabric effects if no audible movement is visible.

variations.name: Full-Length Window Walk
variations.hook: Open with the wearer standing full-length beside a window, showing the exact outfit from head to toe; no text or added logos.
variations.action: The wearer takes one small natural step toward the window and stops; the garment moves only as fabric would.
variations.detail: Preserve the reference neckline, sleeve length, hem, fit, print, colour and styling; no wardrobe changes.
variations.camera: Use a gentle forward track that keeps the entire outfit in frame.
variations.lighting: Soft daylight with neutral white balance and natural shadows.
variations.closing: Hold a steady full-length pose with the complete outfit visible.
variations.audio: Light lifestyle instrumental; voice only if selected.

variations.name: Turn by a Few Degrees
variations.hook: Begin with a clear full-length front view of the actual outfit.
variations.action: The wearer turns just a few degrees and returns to front-facing, only if that movement is consistent with the reference and does not reveal unsupported garment details.
variations.detail: Keep garment length, pattern placement and fit stable; no invented back view or extra accessories.
variations.camera: Use a locked camera and a small natural body turn.
variations.lighting: Even soft studio light, colour accurate.
variations.closing: End on the original front-facing full-length composition.
variations.audio: Soft instrumental, no extra effects.

variations.name: Sleeve Detail and Return
variations.hook: Show the complete outfit first, then move closer to one sleeve that is clearly visible.
variations.action: The camera glides toward the sleeve edge and eases back to the full outfit; the wearer remains relaxed.
variations.detail: Show only the real sleeve cut, cuff and seam if visible; do not invent buttons, lining or fabric composition.
variations.camera: Slow side push-in followed by a smooth pull-back.
variations.lighting: Diffused side light to reveal shape without exaggerating texture.
variations.closing: Finish with the full outfit centred.
variations.audio: Quiet instrumental music.

variations.name: Hemline in Motion
variations.hook: Open on the complete outfit with the hem fully inside the frame.
variations.action: The wearer makes one small step in place so the hem moves naturally, then settles.
variations.detail: Do not lengthen or shorten the garment; preserve the exact silhouette and pattern.
variations.camera: Use a stable low-to-mid camera angle without cropping the hem.
variations.lighting: Soft, even lighting with a clean background.
variations.closing: Hold a full-length final frame after the fabric settles.
variations.audio: Gentle instrumental bed.

variations.name: Neutral Studio Side Light
variations.hook: Reveal the outfit against a plain neutral backdrop, front-facing and full-length.
variations.action: A narrow soft-light gradient shifts across the backdrop while the wearer stays still.
variations.detail: Do not recolour the garment or infer material, comfort or performance.
variations.camera: Use a very slow push-in with natural proportions.
variations.lighting: Neutral studio lighting with subtle side definition.
variations.closing: End on a crisp full-length hero frame.
variations.audio: Minimal instrumental, no voice unless requested.

variations.name: Walk Into a Clear Frame
variations.hook: Begin with a clean empty portion of the selected setting and the wearer already partly visible at the edge, outfit unchanged.
variations.action: The wearer takes one or two calm steps into the centre and stops naturally.
variations.detail: Do not add a bag, jewellery, shoes or other styling items absent from the reference.
variations.camera: Use a gentle lateral track that keeps the full outfit visible throughout.
variations.lighting: Natural daylight, balanced exposure.
variations.closing: Settle into a still front-facing pose.
variations.audio: Soft upbeat instrumental at low volume.

variations.name: Mirror View, Stable Outfit
variations.hook: Open on a full-length mirror view if the selected model and scene support it; otherwise use a direct full-length view.
variations.action: The wearer makes a small posture adjustment only; keep the same person, outfit and camera position.
variations.detail: No phone added unless present in the reference; no reflection mismatch or outfit transformation.
variations.camera: Use a restrained handheld micro-movement, not a fast pan.
variations.lighting: Believable room light and accurate colours.
variations.closing: Finish with the outfit fully visible and the framing steady.
variations.audio: Quiet casual instrumental.

variations.name: Pattern Placement Study
variations.hook: Start with the entire outfit visible so the overall print or colour blocking can be understood.
variations.action: The camera makes a slow horizontal pass across the garment, then returns to a full view.
variations.detail: Keep pattern scale and placement exactly consistent; never create new motifs or seams.
variations.camera: Use a smooth slider movement without extreme close-up distortion.
variations.lighting: Broad soft light, avoiding glare and colour shifts.
variations.closing: End on the complete outfit.
variations.audio: Subtle instrumental, no claims.

variations.name: Walk Along a Plain Wall
variations.hook: Show the wearer in full-length against a simple wall in the selected lifestyle setting.
variations.action: The wearer walks slowly for two short steps parallel to the wall and pauses.
variations.detail: Keep garment drape and body proportions natural; no wind-driven fabric changes unless the scene supports them.
variations.camera: Track sideways at a matched pace, maintaining head-to-toe framing.
variations.lighting: Soft outdoor or window daylight, depending on the chosen setting.
variations.closing: Finish with a still three-quarter stance and the full outfit visible.
variations.audio: Relaxed instrumental.

variations.name: Waist-Up to Full Look
variations.hook: Begin at a medium shot that includes the upper garment details, with enough context to identify the outfit.
variations.action: The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the complete outfit from head to toe.
variations.detail: Do not invent lower garments or shoes if they are not supplied; frame only what the reference supports.
variations.camera: Smooth optical-style pull-back, no sudden zoom.
variations.lighting: Even frontal fill and gentle side light.
variations.closing: Hold the full outfit in the closing frame.
variations.audio: Clean instrumental bed.

variations.name: Natural Seated Moment
variations.hook: Open with the wearer seated only if the garment and setting support a natural seated pose; otherwise use a relaxed standing pose.
variations.action: The wearer makes one small natural adjustment and returns to stillness, with no tugging or restyling.
variations.detail: Avoid creases or folds that falsely change the garment design; preserve all visible details.
variations.camera: Use a stable medium-wide shot with minimal camera drift.
variations.lighting: Soft ambient daylight.
variations.closing: End on the clearest supported view of the outfit.
variations.audio: Low-volume lifestyle music.

variations.name: Doorway Light Frame
variations.hook: Reveal the wearer in a doorway or architectural frame that suits the selected setting, full outfit visible.
variations.action: The wearer steps gently from shade into soft light and stops; no abrupt scene transition.
variations.detail: Keep the outfit colour consistent as lighting changes; do not add accessories or logos.
variations.camera: Slow forward camera move with stable vertical lines.
variations.lighting: Balanced shade and daylight, no overexposure.
variations.closing: Hold a clean full-length hero shot.
variations.audio: Gentle cinematic instrumental.

variations.name: Fabric Drape Close View
variations.hook: Start with the full outfit, then approach one naturally visible area where the fabric falls freely.
variations.action: The wearer shifts weight once, allowing a small natural drape movement without touching or pulling the garment.
variations.detail: Do not identify fabric type or make claims about softness, stretch or breathability.
variations.camera: Use a slow close approach and return to a medium-wide view.
variations.lighting: Large diffused light source for realistic folds.
variations.closing: Finish full-length with the garment settled.
variations.audio: Soft instrumental, no fabric sound added unless natural.

variations.name: Bench-Side Editorial
variations.hook: Show the wearer standing beside a plain bench or seat that fits the scene, keeping the outfit unobstructed.
variations.action: The wearer takes a small step beside the seat and pauses without sitting or handling props.
variations.detail: Do not add accessories or let the seat cover the hem or silhouette.
variations.camera: Use a gentle diagonal dolly to a three-quarter full-length composition.
variations.lighting: Natural side light and subtle fill.
variations.closing: End with the whole outfit visible and the background quiet.
variations.audio: Polished lifestyle instrumental.

variations.name: Stair Landing Pause
variations.hook: Open with the wearer standing safely on a level landing, full outfit visible.
variations.action: The wearer takes a single careful step onto the landing and stops; avoid climbing or dramatic posing.
variations.detail: Maintain realistic garment movement and exact length; no footwear invention if not shown.
variations.camera: Use a locked wide shot with a subtle push-in.
variations.lighting: Soft architectural daylight with accurate colour.
variations.closing: Hold a still full-length final frame.
variations.audio: Light modern instrumental.

variations.name: Colour-True Background Shift
variations.hook: Begin against a plain background chosen to contrast with the outfit's real colour.
variations.action: The camera slides slightly so a second background plane appears; the wearer remains still.
variations.detail: Background contrast must not change the outfit's hue, print or apparent fabric.
variations.camera: Use a controlled lateral slide and steady full-length framing.
variations.lighting: Neutral, colour-accurate studio light.
variations.closing: End on the clearest full outfit silhouette.
variations.audio: Minimal instrumental.

variations.name: Detail Focus Pull
variations.hook: Reveal the entire outfit in a balanced composition before shifting focus to a visible neckline or collar if present.
variations.action: Pull focus briefly to that real detail, then restore sharpness across the full outfit.
variations.detail: No invented collar, buttons, embroidery or neckline shape.
variations.camera: Keep the camera fixed; use a natural focus pull only.
variations.lighting: Soft directional light with no harsh highlights.
variations.closing: Close with the complete outfit sharp and centred.
variations.audio: Quiet elegant instrumental.

variations.name: Golden-Hour Walk, Restrained
variations.hook: Show the wearer in the selected outdoor setting with the outfit fully visible in warm late-day light.
variations.action: The wearer takes one unhurried step and pauses; keep movement small and natural.
variations.detail: Preserve the garment's actual colour despite warm surroundings; no wind or accessories added.
variations.camera: Use a gentle side track at full-length distance.
variations.lighting: Warm background light with neutral fill on the outfit.
variations.closing: Finish with a stable full-body pose.
variations.audio: Soft acoustic instrumental, low volume.

variations.name: Clean Floor-to-Hem Tilt
variations.hook: Open with the full outfit visible, including the hem and the wearer's stance.
variations.action: Tilt upward from the lower silhouette to the upper garment, then return to a full-length view.
variations.detail: Do not crop away the garment or create a false length impression.
variations.camera: Slow controlled tilt with straight vertical lines.
variations.lighting: Even studio lighting, gentle shadows.
variations.closing: Hold the complete outfit in frame.
variations.audio: Minimal instrumental.

variations.name: Soft Backdrop Movement
variations.hook: Show the wearer against a plain backdrop with no objects touching the outfit.
variations.action: A background curtain or sheer panel may shift gently if the scene supports it; the wearer remains still.
variations.detail: Keep moving fabric behind the wearer and away from the garment; no product changes.
variations.camera: Use a locked shot followed by a very small push-in.
variations.lighting: Soft diffused light with faithful colour.
variations.closing: Finish with an unobstructed full-length frame.
variations.audio: Airy instrumental music.

variations.name: Three-Step Editorial Sequence
variations.hook: Begin with a full-length view, then cut once to a supported medium detail and once back to full length.
variations.action: The wearer changes pose minimally between cuts while remaining the same person in the same outfit and setting.
variations.detail: No jump in clothing, hair, accessories, pattern or body proportions.
variations.camera: Use two clean match cuts with consistent camera height and direction.
variations.lighting: Keep exposure and white balance matched across all cuts.
variations.closing: End on a still full-length hero pose.
variations.audio: Modern instrumental with gentle rhythm; no exaggerated impacts.

variations.name: Outdoor Shade Showcase
variations.hook: Reveal the complete outfit in open shade with a calm uncluttered background.
variations.action: The wearer shifts naturally from one foot to the other and settles.

variations.action: Slide the camera from the shadow boundary toward the product until the whole item is clearly revealed; if no distinct shadow exists, use a simple lateral edge-to-full reveal.
variations.detail: Do not exaggerate shadows to imply volume, thickness or construction that the image does not establish.
variations.camera: One smooth lateral slide with stable focus, exposure and horizon.
variations.lighting: Soft side light that preserves natural shadows and the item's true colour.
variations.closing: End with a clear, unobstructed full-item composition.
variations.audio: Subtle instrumental music optional; no artificial wind or impact sounds.

variations.name: Creative Reveal — Matched-Frame Loop
variations.hook: Begin with a complete, stable view of the supplied item and remember the exact opening framing.
variations.action: Make a small push toward one real visible feature and reverse along the same path until the camera returns precisely to the opening composition; the item never changes.
variations.detail: Keep the product orientation, visible details and proportions identical throughout the move.
variations.camera: Slow push-in and matched reverse with locked focus and no jump cut.
variations.lighting: Constant soft illumination and white balance for a seamless visual loop.
variations.closing: Match the opening frame and hold it still at the end.
variations.audio: A short restrained instrumental phrase may resolve smoothly if audio is selected.

variations.name: Doodle Style — Margin-Only Motion
variations.hook: Present the full item clearly against its supplied background, leaving the real outline unobstructed.
variations.action: Keep the product still while the camera makes a tiny slide; optional hand-drawn accents may animate only in empty margins and must never touch or cross the product.
variations.detail: Do not add words, logos, fake stitching, labels or graphic details to the item itself.
variations.camera: Steady product framing with minimal movement; confine graphic motion to background space.
variations.lighting: Even realistic light with faithful colour; do not draw highlights onto the product.
variations.closing: Finish on a clean full-item view with all accents stopped.
variations.audio: Light playful instrumental optional; no cartoon sound effects.

variations.name: Doodle Style — Contour Echo Reveal
variations.hook: Open on the item's genuine outer contour or a confirmed seam, without changing its presentation.
variations.action: Track the camera beside the real contour while an optional sketch-like echo appears in empty background space, then pull back to the complete item.
variations.detail: The doodle must not redraw the item, invent seams or alter the shape, colour or included parts.
variations.camera: A slow short slider move and controlled pullback; maintain a clear gap between graphics and product.
variations.lighting: Soft, neutral lighting with stable colour and natural contact shadows.
variations.closing: Hold the complete item with the real contour intact and graphics confined to the margins.
variations.audio: A gentle playful beat is optional; no pencil-scratch effect unless explicitly selected.

variations.name: Doodle Style — Beat-Stop Product Hero
variations.hook: Start with the complete fashion item centred and all reference-visible parts inside the frame.
variations.action: Keep the item stationary; time one small camera push to a restrained musical beat, stop cleanly, then settle back to the full-item view while any doodle accents pulse only in empty background space.
variations.detail: No symbols, text, logos or decorative marks may appear on the item; do not imply unseen features.
variations.camera: One measured push followed by a smooth return and a still hold, with no bounce or morphing.
variations.lighting: Neutral soft light and fixed white balance throughout.
variations.closing: End on the full product with the camera and all optional decorative motion stopped.
variations.audio: Use a light restrained beat if selected; no exaggerated cartoon effects.

variations.name: Silhouette from shadow
variations.hook: HOOK: Begin with a soft shadow of the handbag on a plain surface; reveal the full bag as the light opens across it. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Keep the bag still while a narrow highlight travels across its visible outline; show only hardware actually present.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Let the handbag's existing silhouette, handle shape and visible fittings emerge gradually; reveal no unseen construction or unsupported features.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Begin with a low three-quarter framing, then make a slow push-in without crossing to an unseen side.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use a broad side light source to define the outline while keeping the handbag's actual colour faithful.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: End on the entire handbag with its handles and visible fittings unobstructed.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Use restrained instrumental music; add no clasp or handling sounds unless the matching action is visible.

variations.name: Hardware first
variations.hook: HOOK: Open on a close detail of a visible clasp, zip or fitting; if none is visible, begin with the front panel instead. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Ease backward from the real detail to reveal the full handbag without opening or manipulating it.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Keep the close-up limited to visible stitching, seams and fittings; do not imply hidden compartments.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a controlled pull-back with the detail and full-product shot aligned on the same axis.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use soft, even light so reflective fittings do not flare or change apparent finish.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Hold a crisp full-product frame with no added accessories.
variations.audio: AUDIO: No sound effect is needed; keep any selected voice clearly above quiet music.

variations.name: Handle arc
variations.hook: HOOK: Frame the handbag upright with its visible handles naturally resting in place. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: If a visible handle can be safely held, lift the bag a few centimetres once and set it back down; otherwise keep it still.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Show how the visible handles join the bag, without stretching, reshaping or adding parts.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a steady medium shot and one brief close-up of the handle attachment, then return wide.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use gentle top-side light with realistic contact shadow beneath the bag.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Finish with the bag upright in its original shape and orientation.
variations.audio: AUDIO: A soft surface-contact sound is acceptable only if the lift and set-down are shown.

variations.name: Front-panel glide
variations.hook: HOOK: Open square-on to the handbag's front panel and let its real design read immediately. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Move nothing on the product; let the camera travel slowly across the visible front, then settle on the whole bag.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Feature only the actual panel design, seams, pockets or decoration visible in the reference.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a short horizontal slider move and avoid a full orbit.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use neutral studio lighting with even exposure across the front panel.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Close on a centred front view at the same scale as the opening.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Use light instrumental music without transition whooshes.

variations.name: Profile reveal
variations.hook: HOOK: Start with a narrow side profile, keeping enough of the handbag visible to identify it. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Make a slow, small turn only if the item can rotate naturally on its support; otherwise move the camera to reveal the visible side.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Show real depth and gusset only where visible; do not invent expandable sides or capacity.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a restrained three-quarter camera move, never a fast spin.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft side lighting reveals depth without exaggerating thickness.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: End at a three-quarter angle that still shows the complete bag.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Keep audio clean and understated; no claims in voiceover.

variations.name: Texture in focus
variations.hook: HOOK: Begin with a close view of a genuinely visible surface texture or pattern; if indistinct, begin on a seam. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Rack focus across the visible surface, then widen to the whole handbag.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Do not label the material or claim softness, durability or water resistance from appearance alone.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a locked macro framing followed by a gentle pull-back.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Diffuse the light to prevent glare and preserve the reference colour.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Hold the full bag sharply in focus for the final beat.
variations.audio: AUDIO: No foley unless the product is visibly touched; optional music stays low.

variations.name: Natural carry
variations.hook: HOOK: Show the complete handbag beside a person only if a model was selected; otherwise use a clean product-only setup. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: If a model is selected and the visible handle allows it, let the bag hang naturally at the model's side for one small step; otherwise keep it stationary.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Preserve the actual size, handle length and shape; do not add outfit accessories that distract from the bag.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a stable waist-height medium shot, then a brief full-product view.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use soft daylight with natural shadows and no beauty-filter glow.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Finish with the bag clearly visible and not hidden behind the model.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Keep footsteps only if they are visible and plausible; music remains subtle.

variations.name: Top opening view
variations.hook: HOOK: Start at a high three-quarter angle that shows the bag opening only if it is already visibly open. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Hold the bag still; do not force the opening or reveal hidden contents.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Show only the visible rim, lining or closure; never add items inside.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Lower the camera gently from the high angle toward a normal hero view.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use soft overhead fill so the opening remains legible without harsh shadows.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Return to a complete, undistorted view of the handbag.
variations.audio: AUDIO: No zipper or clasp sound unless that action is explicitly visible.

variations.name: Slow orbit quarter-turn
variations.hook: HOOK: Open on the handbag's strongest visible front angle. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Rotate the display by at most a small quarter-turn if physically supported; otherwise make a camera-only arc around the visible side.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Keep every transition consistent with the real construction and never reveal imagined back details.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use one slow quarter-arc and stop before the product's unseen side dominates.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Keep light direction fixed so the product colour stays consistent.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: End with the original front-facing hero composition.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Use a calm music bed; avoid cinematic impacts or exaggerated sound design.

variations.name: Final detail to hero
variations.hook: HOOK: Begin on the most distinctive visible feature, such as a real pattern, seam or fitting. No on-screen text, captions or extra logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Pull back smoothly to the full handbag and hold; no product transformation.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Make the detail recognisable but do not invent logos, labels or hidden features.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use one continuous pull-back with stable focus and no jump cuts.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use balanced softbox-style light with realistic reflections.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Leave the complete bag centred in a clean final frame.
variations.audio: AUDIO: No extra sound effects; follow the selected speech and music settings.

variations.name: Tabletop Reflection Reveal
variations.hook: HOOK: Begin with a soft reflection of the handbag on a clean reflective tabletop, then gently tilt the camera until the actual bag is fully visible. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Keep the handbag completely still while the camera changes angle to reveal its real front and handle silhouette.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Use the reflection only as a visual composition; preserve the exact colour, proportions, visible pattern and fittings from the reference.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Start low at tabletop height and perform one slow upward tilt into a three-quarter product view.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use controlled soft studio light with a believable reflection and no blown highlights.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Hold a clean, complete three-quarter view with the reflection subtle and the bag unobstructed.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Quiet polished instrumental music; no artificial sparkle or impact effects.

variations.name: Unboxing Without Claims
variations.hook: HOOK: Show the handbag resting in its actual packaging only if packaging is present in the reference; otherwise open directly on the bag against a simple surface. No added text or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: If packaging is shown and can be moved naturally, slide it aside once to reveal the unchanged handbag; otherwise use a camera reveal only.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Do not invent gift boxes, dust bags, tags or included accessories; show only items actually supplied in the reference.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a top-down start and a gentle diagonal move into a front three-quarter angle.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft even lighting keeps the true product colour and packaging details readable.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Finish with the handbag alone and fully visible, unless the original reference clearly includes its packaging as part of the product.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Subtle instrumental bed; add paper or packaging sounds only when that movement is visible.

variations.name: Handle Shadow Geometry
variations.hook: HOOK: Open on the real shadow cast by the handbag's handles, with part of the bag already visible so the product is identifiable. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Move a soft light source slightly to shift the shadow while the handbag remains still and unchanged.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Keep the handle count, curve, attachment points and silhouette faithful to the reference; do not create extra handles in the shadow.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a locked side-three-quarter composition with a very slow push toward the handle and upper edge.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Shape a gentle directional shadow without changing the perceived product colour.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Ease back to a full product frame with the real handles clearly outlined.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Minimal instrumental music at low volume; no sound effects needed.

variations.name: Seam-Line Tracking Shot
variations.hook: HOOK: Start at one visible seam or edge that naturally leads the eye across the handbag. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Track the camera along the existing seam and gradually widen to reveal the whole bag; the product does not move.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Show only visible stitching, piping or panel joins, without claiming handmade construction or special durability.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a smooth macro-to-medium tracking move with stable focus and no abrupt zoom.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Broad grazing light reveals real edges without exaggerating texture.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Settle into a balanced front three-quarter hero shot of the complete handbag.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Gentle modern instrumental music; avoid whooshes that compete with optional voice-over.

variations.name: Colour-True Neutral Sweep
variations.hook: HOOK: Present the handbag against a neutral background that contrasts naturally with its actual colour. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Sweep the camera slowly from one side of the front panel to the other, then pause on the full product.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Preserve the reference colour and pattern exactly; do not recolour the bag or add decorative elements.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a straight, short slider move at product height, keeping perspective natural.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use neutral white balance and soft diffused light to avoid colour shifts.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: End on a centred, colour-accurate full view with all visible edges in frame.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Clean low-volume instrumental bed; spoken content, if enabled, remains clear.

variations.name: Seat-Height Lifestyle Placement
variations.hook: HOOK: In model mode, show the handbag beside a seated adult on a bench; in product-only mode, place it on a simple bench or plinth. No added text or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: If a model is selected, the adult gently places the bag beside them once, only using a visible handle and a physically plausible grip; otherwise keep the bag still and let the camera approach.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Keep the bag's scale realistic and do not let hands, clothing or the bench hide its defining features.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Start in a medium lifestyle frame and make a slow push-in to a full-bag composition.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use natural soft daylight and retain the handbag's true colour.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Hold a relaxed lifestyle hero frame with the whole handbag clearly visible.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Soft lifestyle instrumental music; include movement sounds only if they match visible actions.

variations.name: Organised Negative Space
variations.hook: HOOK: Place the handbag off-centre with generous empty space around it, while keeping the full silhouette visible from the first moment. No added text or graphics.
variations.action: ACTION: Keep the bag stationary as the camera slowly reframes from the negative space toward the product.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Do not fill the empty space with invented props, labels or promotional claims; preserve the real bag details.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a restrained lateral pan ending in a balanced composition without cropping handles or base.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft directional studio light with a natural contact shadow beneath the bag.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Finish with the handbag as the clear focal point, fully in frame against the uncluttered background.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Refined minimal music at low volume; no exaggerated transitions.

variations.name: Base and Structure Study
variations.hook: HOOK: Begin at a low angle that shows the handbag's visible base and lower outline without tipping or deforming it. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Move the camera from the lower edge upward to the front panel; do not turn the bag over or reveal unseen underside details.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Show only the visible base shape, seams and contact points. Do not claim it is reinforced or waterproof unless verified.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Make a slow vertical tilt from low product height to a medium three-quarter view.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use soft side fill to define the outline while keeping shadows natural.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Return to a full upright view with the base and handles visible together.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Quiet instrumental music; no fabricated handling sounds.

variations.name: Window-Sill Morning Scene
variations.hook: HOOK: Reveal the handbag in a calm morning window-light setting, with the complete product visible immediately and no added text or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: Let natural-looking light shift subtly across the bag while the product remains in place; no wind or object movement is required.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Keep all visible colour, pattern, seams and hardware consistent; avoid adding flowers, scarves or other accessories unless present in the reference.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Begin at a medium-wide angle and make a slow diagonal push to a three-quarter hero view.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Use soft daylight and gentle fill; avoid overexposure or warm tint that alters the product colour.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Hold the full handbag against the quiet window-lit background for a clean final beat.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Light warm instrumental music at low volume; voice-over, if enabled, stays prominent.

variations.name: One-Hand Lift and Settle
variations.hook: HOOK: Open on the handbag resting upright, with its complete shape and visible handle clearly shown. No added text, captions or logos.
variations.action: ACTION: If a model is selected and the handle design supports it, an adult hand lifts the bag a few centimetres once and sets it back down gently; if the grip or handle is unclear, use a camera-only reveal.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Preserve realistic weight and shape; no swinging, stretching, collapsing or sudden changes to the handles.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Use a stable medium close-up during the lift, then pull back slightly to show the full bag after it settles.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Keep lighting even so the product colour and visible details remain unchanged.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Let the bag settle naturally and hold a steady full-product shot.
variations.audio: AUDIO: A soft contact sound only if the set-down is visible; background music stays understated.

variations.name: Diagonal Shadow Reveal
variations.hook: Start with the full handbag beside a crisp diagonal shadow, fully visible and unchanged; no text or added logos.
variations.action: Let the camera travel across the shadow line toward the bag while the bag itself remains still.
variations.detail: Keep the visible silhouette, handles, colour and hardware identical; the shadow is environmental only.
variations.camera: Use a slow lateral slide that ends in a front three-quarter view.
variations.lighting: Use directional studio light with a soft fill, without recolouring the product.
variations.closing: Finish with the entire handbag clearly framed and hold the shot.
variations.audio: Low instrumental bed only; no invented handling sounds.

variations.name: Handle Framing Composition
variations.hook: Open with the handbag fully visible, its actual handle shape naturally framing the upper silhouette.
variations.action: Move the camera gently upward from the body to the handle, then ease back to include the whole bag.
variations.detail: Show only the handle attachment and construction that are visibly present; do not imply load capacity.
variations.camera: Use a controlled tilt-up followed by a slow pull-back.
variations.lighting: Use soft top-side lighting to separate handle and body without harsh glare.
variations.closing: Hold a balanced full-product hero frame with the handle unobstructed.
variations.audio: Soft instrumental music, restrained and without extra sound effects.

variations.name: Colour-True Neutral Studio
variations.hook: Reveal the handbag against a muted neutral background with its actual colour represented faithfully.
variations.action: Make one small camera arc around the front-facing area without exposing unseen sides.
variations.detail: Preserve exact hue, print, finish and visible hardware; no stylized colour grading.
variations.camera: Use a short, limited arc that never becomes a fabricated 360-degree rotation.
variations.lighting: Use neutral white balance and even diffused lighting.
variations.closing: End on a still front or three-quarter view, matching the reference appearance.
variations.audio: Quiet modern instrumental; no dialogue unless the user's settings request it.

variations.name: Shelf-Level Editorial
variations.hook: Begin with the handbag placed securely on a clean shelf or plinth, full shape in frame.
variations.action: The camera glides at shelf height from one side toward the front, while the bag stays still.
variations.detail: Do not add books, jewellery or props that could be mistaken as included accessories.
variations.camera: Use a low, smooth horizontal dolly move with realistic perspective.
variations.lighting: Use soft side light and a natural contact shadow beneath the bag.
variations.closing: Settle into a clear upright hero composition.
variations.audio: Subtle instrumental music at low volume.

variations.name: Soft Fabric Backdrop
variations.hook: Show the complete handbag against a softly draped plain backdrop that stays behind the product.
variations.action: A gentle breeze may move only the backdrop slightly; the handbag remains stable and unchanged.
variations.detail: Do not let fabric touch or cover the bag; do not imply the backdrop is included.
variations.camera: Use a slow push-in with the bag kept sharp and centred.
variations.lighting: Use broad soft light with restrained highlights.
variations.closing: Pull back to a clean full-product view and hold.
variations.audio: Airy instrumental bed; no added fabric sounds unless visible and natural.

variations.name: Reflected Light Sweep
variations.hook: Start on a clear full handbag shot with a faint reflected highlight on the background, not a new product feature.
variations.action: A soft light sweep passes across the surrounding set, then gently across visible hardware only if physically plausible.
variations.detail: Do not change the finish, add sparkle to unseen details or exaggerate shine.
variations.camera: Keep the camera locked with a very subtle push-in.
variations.lighting: Use controlled studio reflections and faithful product colour.
variations.closing: Finish with the bag fully visible and the lighting settled.
variations.audio: Minimal instrumental music, no artificial sparkle sound.

variations.name: Front Panel Geometry
variations.hook: Open with the front panel squarely framed and the whole handbag still visible.
variations.action: Move in slowly toward the front panel, then return to a medium full view without rotating the bag.
variations.detail: Show only real seams, folds, pattern placement and closure details visible in the reference.
variations.camera: Use a steady push-in and pull-back, avoiding lens distortion.
variations.lighting: Use even frontal light with soft side fill.
variations.closing: End on a composed front-facing hero shot.
variations.audio: Calm instrumental music, no spoken claims.

variations.name: Three-Quarter Silhouette
variations.hook: Reveal the handbag in a natural three-quarter orientation supported by the reference image.
variations.action: The camera makes a small arc of only a few degrees to emphasise the existing silhouette.
variations.detail: Do not reveal unseen sides, interior layout or hidden pockets.
variations.camera: Use a restrained short arc with stable proportions.
variations.lighting: Use gentle rim light and neutral fill.
variations.closing: Hold the same three-quarter angle for a polished ending.
variations.audio: Elegant instrumental music at low volume.

variations.name: Quiet Dressing Table
variations.hook: Place the handbag on a tidy dressing-table surface with generous empty space and no competing products.
variations.action: A model's hand may enter only if model interaction is selected, lightly straightening the bag's existing handle without changing its shape; otherwise camera-only.
variations.detail: No cosmetics, jewellery, wallet or extra items unless explicitly present in the reference.
variations.camera: Use a slow diagonal push from the open side of the composition toward the bag.
variations.lighting: Use warm-neutral daylight while preserving exact product colours.
variations.closing: Finish with the handbag alone as the clear hero.

variations.name: Monochrome Set Contrast
variations.hook: Frame the bag against a single-tone set chosen to contrast with its actual colour, keeping the product fully visible.
variations.action: Shift focus gently from the plain background to the handbag without moving the product.

variations.camera: Use a locked composition and one natural focus pull.
variations.lighting: Use controlled, neutral lighting without clipping highlights.
variations.closing: Hold the sharp, full-product frame for the closing beat.
variations.audio: Minimal ambient instrumental, quiet.

variations.name: Close Detail to Whole
variations.hook: Open on one clearly visible detail such as a handle attachment, seam or clasp, chosen only if present.
variations.action: Slowly widen the view until the entire handbag is revealed, without inventing a hidden angle.
variations.detail: The initial detail must belong to this exact bag and remain geometrically consistent.
variations.camera: Use a smooth optical-style pull-back rather than a sudden digital zoom.
variations.lighting: Use soft macro-friendly light and consistent white balance.
variations.closing: Finish with the complete bag centred and in focus.
variations.audio: Light instrumental bed; no exaggerated sound design.

variations.name: Top-Edge View
variations.hook: Begin with a slightly elevated angle that still shows the full handbag and its overall silhouette.
variations.action: Tilt down modestly toward the visible top edge, then return to the original composition.
variations.detail: Do not open the bag or expose an interior that is not shown in the reference.
variations.camera: Use a careful downward tilt with no rotation beyond the visible view.
variations.lighting: Use diffuse overhead light and soft fill to avoid darkening the bag.
variations.closing: Return to the full, upright hero view and hold.
variations.audio: Subtle instrumental music, no added zipper or clasp sound unless shown.

variations.name: Grounded Contact Shadow
variations.hook: Show the handbag resting naturally on a matte surface with a visible contact shadow.

variations.camera: Use a gentle tilt-up with a short push toward the hero framing.
variations.lighting: Use soft directional lighting that preserves a plausible shadow.
variations.closing: Finish with the bag grounded and fully in frame.
variations.audio: Quiet premium instrumental.

variations.name: Circular Light Pool
variations.hook: Reveal the handbag inside a soft pool of light on a plain studio surface, with the full product visible.

variations.detail: Keep the lighting effect on the environment; no glowing product edges or invented materials.
variations.camera: Use a slow push-in from a medium-wide composition.
variations.lighting: Use a restrained spotlight with soft edges and faithful colour balance.
variations.closing: Hold a clean hero view as the light settles.
variations.audio: Minimal cinematic instrumental, no synthetic whoosh.

variations.name: Walk-Past Background
variations.hook: Show the handbag on a stable display surface in a calm, uncluttered environment.
variations.action: A distant background figure may pass softly out of focus only if a model is allowed; the handbag stays still and dominant.
variations.detail: No person should touch or block the product; do not add an implied store or brand.
variations.camera: Use a fixed camera with shallow, natural background separation.
variations.lighting: Use soft ambient daylight and natural shadows.
variations.closing: Finish on the bag alone in a steady full-product frame.
variations.audio: Quiet lifestyle music; no crowd noise unless visible and appropriate.

variations.name: Mirrorless Reflection
variations.hook: Frame the handbag beside a subtle reflective surface that shows only a plausible reflection of the visible bag.
variations.action: Slide the camera a short distance so the reflection shifts naturally while the product remains stationary.
variations.detail: Reflection must match the actual visible product; do not reveal hidden sides or extra logos.
variations.camera: Use a measured lateral slide, maintaining correct perspective.
variations.lighting: Use controlled soft lighting to avoid distracting glare.
variations.closing: Settle with the real handbag fully visible, reflection secondary.
